phase: Phase 29: RF & Media Hardening (Dynamic Adaptive Mesh Bitrate Tuning)

stories.title: Real-Time Mesh Link Quality Scoring & EWMA Loss Estimator
stories.description: Implement MeshLinkQualityScorer.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ calculating a composite link quality score Q_link in [0, 100] by fusing EWMA RSSI link margin, moving Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), jitter gradient, and ETX with pure KMP math.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates composite Q_link score (0-100) combining smoothed RSSI margin, PDR, jitter, and ETX
Provides fine-grained LinkQualityGrade (EXCELLENT, GOOD, FAIR, POOR, CRITICAL)

stories.title: Dynamic Adaptive Bitrate & Frame Sizing Controller
stories.description: Implement AdaptiveBitrateEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/ to dynamically map composite Q_link into codec bitrates (16 kbps to 48 kbps) and frame consolidation sizes (20ms to 60ms) with fast step-down (<200ms) and conservative hysteresis step-up (3 cycles).
acceptanceCriteria: Closed-loop adaptation shifting AudioProfile and frame size based on Q_link and RF interference
Immediate rapid step-down on link degradation (<200ms)
Configurable hysteresis step-up (default 3 cycles) to prevent bitrate oscillation/flapping
Manual profile override and lock capability

stories.title: Audio Pipeline Dynamic Frame Multiplexing & Cockpit Telemetry Wiring
stories.description: Integrate AdaptiveBitrateEngine and MeshLinkQualityScorer into AudioPipelineSession.kt, IntercomHardwareBridge.kt, and IntercomBridge.kt (iOS Swift interop). Update HomeUiState, TactileDiagnosticsSheet.kt, and TactileAvionicsHeader to display live negotiated bitrate and Q_link score.
acceptanceCriteria: Audio pipeline dynamically encodes using the active negotiated bitrate profile
Hardware bridge and iOS IntercomBridge stream live negotiated bitrate and Q_link to UI
TactileDiagnosticsSheet displays real-time calculated Q_link and negotiated bitrate
Adheres to Rule 1 (100% Native SwiftUI on iOS) and Rule 2 (KMP shared logic)

stories.title: Multi-Node Dynamic Bitrate Simulation Test & Multiplatform Certification
stories.description: Implement AdaptiveBitrateSimulationTest.kt in commonTest simulating 8-node RF fading and congestion, verifying rapid bitrate step-down, cluster-wide worst-link protection, and execute full multiplatform verification gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulation test verifies dynamic downshift during simulated RF dropouts and recovery
100% test pass across all multiplatform test tasks (Rule 6)
Clean Android assemble and iOS simulator compilation (Rule 6)
